notes: Throughput is based on the observed one-step-per-cycle hourly cadence: each firing marks the previous task DONE and claims the next. Every kit step (10 to 30 minutes) fit inside one hour.
A GitHub merge trigger on the routine would start the next cycle as soon as a merge lands, allowing back-to-back cycles and more than one task per hour.
At a usage limit the task goes to RETRY_AFTER_RESET and the next hourly run after the reset picks it up; never pay per use (BUILD_BRIEF.md:274, BUILD_BRIEF.md:509).
The Haiku samples come from tiny rehearsal tasks and understate a real build task; K0 is the closest sample of real work.
A live lease naming a different session always means stop (D-171).
